source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT DISTINCT CST_UNIID  as Cust_UniId,
                CST_NO     as Cust_Cd,
                CST_Nm_Cn   as Cust_NmCn,
                CST_Nm_En   as Cust_NmEn,
                CST_CTY_CD as City_Cd,
                CST_STA_DT as Start_Dt,
                CST_END_DT as End_Dt,
                GETDATE()
FROM [MVIEW].[MDM_BYS_CST_MV] T1

SELECT DISTINCT CST_UNIID,
                CST_NO,
                CST_NAM_CN,
                CST_NAM_EN,
                CST_ACC_GRP,
                CST_ACC_GRP_DES,
                CST_ACC_GRP_DES,
                CST_GRP,
                CST_GRP_DES_CN,
                CST_GRP_DES_EN,
                CST_CTY_CD,
                CST_STA_DT,
                CST_END_DT,
                GETDATE()
FROM [MVIEW].[MDM_CST_MST_MV] T1

SELECT T1.PLT_UNIID,
T1.PLT_CD,
T1.PLT_NAM,
T1.NTS_REG_CD,
T1.NTS_REG_DES,
T1.PLT_REG_CD,
T1.PLT_REG_DES,
T1.PLT_CTG_CD,
T1.PLT_CTG_DES,
T1.PLT_CTY_CD,
T1.PLT_CTY_DES,
NULL [1],
NULL [2],
Case when T1.PLT_INA_FLG='Y' THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END [3],
T1.PLT_STA_DT,
T1.PLT_END_DT,
getdate() [4]
from  [MVIEW].[MDM_PLT_DC_MST_MV] T1
where T1.PLT_TYP = 'DC'

SELECT
Location_UniId,
Address,
Longitude,
Latitude,
Country_Cd,
Country_NmCn,
Country_NmEn,
Province_Cd,
Province_NmCn,
Province_NmEn,
City_Cd,
City_NmCn,
City_NmEn,
District_Cd,
District_NmCn,
District_NmEn,
Sub_District_Lv1_Nm,
Sub_District_Lv2_Nm,
Main_Road_Nm,
Second_Road_Nm,
Zone_Address,
House_No,
Building_No,
Room_Desc,
Start_Dt,
End_Dt,
Etl_Tm
FROM 
NESZ_DIM.DIM_Location

select
Material_UniId,
Material_Cd,
Material_NmCn,
Material_NmEn,
Material_Type_Cd,
Material_Type_Desc,
Material_Grp_Cd,
Material_Grp_Desc,
Material_Plant_Status_Cd,
Material_Plant_Status_Desc,
Material_Base_Unit,
Material_Supply_Unit,
Grs_Weight,
Net_Weight,
Weight_Unit,
Volume,
Uom_of_vol,
Min_Shelf_Life,
Total_Shelf_Life,
Material_Trasport_Cd,
Material_Trasport_Desc,
Material_Storage_Condition_Cd,
Material_Storage_Condition_Desc,
Effective_Dt,
Start_Dt,
End_Dt,
Etl_Tm
from
NESZ_DIM.DIM_Material

SELECT 
Company_Cd,
Company_InternalNm,
Company_NmCn,
Company_NmEn,
Company_Type,
Start_Dt,
End_Dt,
Etl_Tm
from 
NESZ_DIM.DIM_NestleCompany
